avis.titre: My Skin is So Happy and Refreshed
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive dry skin. Since it's summer, even though my natural skin tone is tan, am prone to sunburns, and when that happens, it flares my other skin issues. I was so nervous to try another new product, but this face mist is so refreshing and now my favorite go-to when I need a boost of hydration. I find no irritation and it helps a lot with keeping my skin clear of bumps, acne, redness, rashes, and peeling. FYI the details and instructions on the bottle are in French, but I generally just spray all over my face and neck when I need hydration or feeling like I have tired skin. I find that after I let it dry on my face I do need to follow up with a little face lotion because it makes my pores small and skin feeling kind of tight. Overall, a treat for my skin, get this if you're a lazy girl like me and want a quick 1-step hydrating routine.

I’ve suffered severe eczema flares on my entire body for nearly 40yr. One of the only things that’s ever been immediately and thoroughly effective on my skin was going to hot springs, they’d clear my skin almost immediately and it would last for months. This summer I’ve paired this mist with the La Roche Posay AP+M Lipikar moisturizer and my skin has never ever felt better than it does after a week of using this BioThermal Mist paired w/ their AP+M Lipikar moisturizer. The texture of this water is smooth as silk, takes a little time to fully absorb but when it does it takes the rich moisturizer with it and leaves my skin quenched and smooth as satin…beyond grateful for La Roche Posay!! Thank you!!!

avis.titre: 1. Refrescante y perfecta para piel sensible
avis.texte: Estoy muy satisfecha con este producto. El agua termal de La Roche-Posay se siente refrescante y calmante en la piel desde la primera aplicación. La uso después de limpiar mi rostro, cuando siento la piel irritada o simplemente para refrescarme durante el día. Es ideal para piel sensible porque no irrita, no tiene fragancia fuerte y deja una sensación ligera y agradable. Además, el envase en spray distribuye muy bien el producto y dura bastante tiempo. Definitivamente lo recomiendo si buscas algo sencillo pero efectivo para hidratar, calmar y cuidar la piel.

Overview: La Roche-Posay Thermal Spring Water is a soothing, hydrating face mist designed to calm and hydrate the skin. Enriched with antioxidants and trace elements, it’s formulated to provide instant relief for dry, irritated, or sensitive skin. Ideal for use throughout the day, this thermal spring water mist can be used as a quick refresh, as a toner, or even after a skincare routine to seal in moisture. Packaging: The mist comes in a sleek, easy-to-hold aerosol can. The packaging is simple, with the brand’s signature blue and white design, and it’s compact enough for travel or to keep in your bag for on-the-go use. The nozzle dispenses a fine, even mist, ensuring that the product is applied lightly and doesn’t create a heavy, wet feeling on the skin. Ingredients & Benefits: The primary ingredient in this mist is La Roche-Posay's famous thermal spring water, known for its soothing properties. It contains minerals and trace elements that help to reduce inflammation, calm redness, and provide hydration. The formula is also rich in antioxidants, which help to protect the skin from environmental stressors like pollution or UV exposure. This mist is free from preservatives, parabens, and alcohol, making it suitable for sensitive skin. It’s hypoallergenic and dermatologist-tested, ensuring it’s safe for most skin types, even for those with conditions like rosacea or eczema. avis.titre: I'm in love with this product !
avis.texte: I just turned 38, and after not taking proper care of my skin for years, I decided to start once I noticed my skin was aging horribly. I used really expensive skincare products at the time and they really didn't make a big difference. I have melasma and started to see some dimpling plus of course, wrinkles. I got a chemical peel which was good, but left me with an over sensitive skin and compromised natural barrier. I stopped using lancôme products because they are way too irritating for my skin. I started using CeraVe and LaRoche Possay moisturizers for sensitive skin which are also so soft and kind to my skin, I also love they are very budget friendly. But I didn't really like the feeling on my skin, it felt too thick and bulky so I thought I would try a lightweight spray or something, good thing I checked on Amazon, because I haven't seen this at the drugstore. In case anyone is experiencing problems with aging, over sensitive skin and you find my skincare routine useful, I now use a lanolin-avocado gel to wash my face, the alcohol free toner from La Roche Possay which is alcohol free, I use a few vitamin C drops in the morning and immediately apply this spray to prevent dryness and flaking... After that I apply a mineral sunscreen, I use skinmedica, but La Roche Possay has some really good ones as well. At night I repeat almost the same steps but use retinol instead of vitamin C. Also some moisturizers for the eye area, so my skin is starting to feel and look so much bett

avis.titre: La Roche-posay Thermal Spring Water Spray
avis.texte: The spray is refreshing after facial cleansing as a calming toner, but it is also good for travel or anytime exposed to dry air for any length of time, like from a furnace or air conditioner. A quick spray helps to rehydrate tight skin. It is also a way to revitalize without actually splashing water on the face and disrupting make-up. The thermal spring water comes out in a very fine mist so it can be used not just before applying moisturizer to help lock it in, but any time throughout the day as a way to wake-up the skin and shed a bit of that grimy feeling that seems to accumulate in the course of the day. A way to feel human again. It is also particularly helpful to soothe skin after being out in face chapping cold temperatures as well as in face flushing heat. There is no fragrance and is suitable for any gender. Made in France, this is a product that is pleasant to use -- a small manageable indulgence.
